parsed_json.up: Select the first 200 rows from the metabolism table. Join to compound_records on substrate_record_id to get substrate compound name. Join to compound_structures on molregno to get canonical SMILES. Join to molecule_hierarchy on molregno to get parent_molregno, then join to molecule_dictionary on parent_molregno to get parent compound name. Return canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, and pathway_key. Do not sort. Do not deduplicate.
